properties.description: Public facilities in Chicago for location-allocation / coverage: hospitals (Overture places, de-duplicated within 300 m, approximate), Chicago Public Library branches, CPS schools (SY2024-25 locations), CFD fire stations. names.csv rows align with the columns.
storyNotes: Hospitals come from Overture (the city hospital list is a 2011 file) so the count is approximate; verify before citing.
CPS schools (~650 incl. charters) far outnumber fire stations (~90): good for contrasting 5-minute vs 15-minute coverage standards.
Small, well-defined point sets suited to coverage-gap, p-median and nearest-facility scenes.
